sourceNotes: 关于页新增「更多应用」分组，提供 51Code 项目入口
Mole 清理预览与清理共用默认关闭的管理员授权选项
修复切换应用图标影响签名校验及 Widget、Finder 登记的问题
修复 Mole 操作期间停止按钮错位

en: The About page adds a More Apps section with a link to 51Code.
Mole cleanup previews and cleanup share an administrator authorization option, off by default. If authorization is canceled or fails, the operation continues with standard privileges.
Fix app icon changes affecting code-signature verification and Widget and Finder registration.
Fix the misaligned Stop button while Mole is running.
